# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-lite-ref

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`coop` with shared git (`--git`) and the reference settings (`gemini-3.8-flash` on Vertex AI, `medium` thinking, 500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap, 4 pairs at a time) on the 100-pair `lite` subset. It is the `coop --git` half of the 100-pair comparison against [`solo` on `lite`](../solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-lite-ref/summary.md) (75/100) and also gives a third `coop --git` reference result on the 50 `flash` pairs included in `lite`.

## Observations

- 73/100 (73%) vs. 75/100 for `solo` on the same 100 pairs (score difference of 2). All 200 agents submitted before the 500-step limit (median 69 steps, max 159), all 100 pairs merged cleanly with zero conflicts, and all 27 failed pairs still had one of the two features pass.
- Pair by pair against `solo` on `lite`, 70 pairs passed in both settings, 22 failed in both, and 8 flipped: 5 passed only in `solo` (`llama_index_task/17244` (2,6) and four `pallets_click_task/2068` pairs: (5,11), (6,7), (7,10), (9,11)) and 3 passed only in `coop --git` (`react_hook_form_task/85` (3,4), `samuelcolvin_dirty_equals_task/43` (6,7), `typst_task/6554` (6,10)).
- Four of the 5 `solo`-only pairs are in `pallets_click_task/2068`. In 7 of the 11 `pallets_click_task/2068` pairs on `lite`, agents still avoid editing the single-line `ed = Editor(...)` call in `src/click/termui.py` at the same time by having one agent set `ed.<attr> = <attr>` after construction so `git merge` has zero conflicts; that workaround fails when the feature's hidden test mocks `Editor` and checks constructor keyword arguments (such as feature 6 in (6,7)). Outside `pallets_click_task` (20 pairs), `coop --git` scored 63/80 vs. 61/80 for `solo`.
- On the 50 `flash` pairs within `lite`, `coop --git` scored 31/50 vs. 34/50 for `solo` (after 35/50 and 33/50 in the two earlier `coop --git` reference runs on `flash`; across all three runs, 30 pairs passed every time, 14 failed every time, and 6 changed outcome). On the 50 pairs not in `flash`, `coop --git` scored 42/50 vs. 41/50 for `solo`.
- Cost `$199.72` (`$2.00` per pair) over 576 minutes, with 43 rate-limit and 2 server-busy retries.
